import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
# I2:K6
# I2: 'Open as of today' - records open today (2022-08-01). Open if created <= today and not closed before today.
# J2: 'Open by end of May 2022' - created <= 2022-05-31 and not closed before 2022-05-31
# K2: 'Open by end of Jun 2022' - created <= 2022-06-30 and not closed before 2022-06-30
# L2: 'Open by end of Jul 2022' - created <= 2022-07-31 and not closed before 2022-07-31
# A record is open if created <= last day of month AND (closed is empty OR closed >= first day of month)
# i.e. not closed before first day of month.
# For 'today' = 2022-08-01, first day = 2022-08-01, last day = 2022-08-01.
# For May: first=2022-05-01, last=2022-05-31
# For Jun: first=2022-06-01, last=2022-06-30
# For Jul: first=2022-07-01, last=2022-07-31

# I2: open as of today (2022-08-01)
ws['I2'] = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,8,1),D:D,\"=\"&\"\")'
# Actually need: created <= today AND (closed empty OR closed >= today)
# =COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,8,1),D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,8,1)) + COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,8,1),D:D,\"\")
# Simpler: COUNTIFS with two conditions on D.
# Let me use SUMPRODUCT or COUNTIFS.
# For each month, first day and last day.
# Open if created <= last AND (closed empty OR closed >= first)
# = COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&last, D:D,\">=\"&first) + COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&last, D:D,\"\")
# But closed empty means open. closed >= first means not closed before first.
# Actually closed >= first means closed on or after first day, so still open at end of month.
# closed < first means closed before month, so not open.
# So open = created <= last AND (closed empty OR closed >= first)
# = COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&last, D:D,\">=\"&first) + COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&last, D:D,\"\")

# I2: today = 2022-08-01
ws['I2'] = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,8,1),D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,8,1))+COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,8,1),D:D,\"\")'
# J2: May 2022
ws['J2'] = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,5,31),D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,5,1))+COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,5,31),D:D,\"\")'
# K2: Jun 2022
ws['K2'] = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,6,30),D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,6,1))+COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,6,30),D:D,\"\")'
# L2: Jul 2022
ws['L2'] = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,7,31),D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,7,1))+COUNTIFS(B:B,G2,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,7,31),D:D,\"\")'

for r in range(3,7):
    ws['I%d'%r] = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G%d,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,8,1),D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,8,1))+COUNTIFS(B:B,G%d,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,8,1),D:D,\"\")'%r
    ws['J%d'%r] = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G%d,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,5,31),D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,5,1))+COUNTIFS(B:B,G%d,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,5,31),D:D,\"\")'%r
    ws['K%d'%r] = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G%d,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,6,30),D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,6,1))+COUNTIFS(B:B,G%d,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,6,30),D:D,\"\")'%r
    ws['L%d'%r] = '=COUNTIFS(B:B,G%d,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,7,31),D:D,\">=\"&DATE(2022,7,1))+COUNTIFS(B:B,G%d,D:D,\"<=\"&DATE(2022,7,31),D:D,\"\")'%r

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
